g.text: A4: PA5/PB7 and A5: PA6/PA15 depend on solder bridges; actual board settings unconfirmed.

g.desc: A4: PA5/PB7 and A5: PA6/PA15 depend on solder bridges; actual board settings unconfirmed.

g.text: Pin assignments and component values are unchanged from revision 0.5.

g.desc: Pin assignments and component values are unchanged from revision 0.5.

g.text: CN4-5 is IN-COM[4-7]. CN4-22 is a different GND terminal and is not used as the ZHOME return.

g.desc: CN4-5 is IN-COM[4-7]. CN4-22 is a different GND terminal and is not used as the ZHOME return.

g.text: Native KiCad and SVG are scalable; zoom in to inspect the full pin labels.

g.desc: Native KiCad and SVG are scalable; zoom in to inspect the full pin labels.

g.text: 24V negative is connected to CN4-5 (IN-COM[4-7]), NOT CN4-22 (GND).

g.desc: 24V negative is connected to CN4-5 (IN-COM[4-7]), NOT CN4-22 (GND).

g.text: GND and +3V3 are the shared MCU supply references. 0V_AB and 0V_CD are independent 24V returns.

g.desc: GND and +3V3 are the shared MCU supply references. 0V_AB and 0V_CD are independent 24V returns.

g.text: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO. Minus: MCU GND. No interface parts (as-built).

g.desc: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO. Minus: MCU GND. No interface parts (as-built).

g.text: Manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs; 3.3V operation is outside that voltage specification.

g.desc: Manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs; 3.3V operation is outside that voltage specification.

g.text: AC/PE, motor, encoder, brake and other I/O wiring not yet recorded. X = not drawn, not confirmed unused.

g.desc: AC/PE, motor, encoder, brake and other I/O wiring not yet recorded. X = not drawn, not confirmed unused.

g.text: K1: PA0 HIGH closes COM -> NO; shared 3V3 reaches sensor PB0.

g.desc: K1: PA0 HIGH closes COM -> NO; shared 3V3 reaches sensor PB0.

g.text: A_CW/A_CCW/A_HOME link the motor MCU to axis A; B/C/D use the same naming rule.

g.desc: A_CW/A_CCW/A_HOME link the motor MCU to axis A; B/C/D use the same naming rule.

g.text: Identical labels are electrical connections; a long drawn wire is not required between equal labels.

g.desc: Identical labels are electrical connections; a long drawn wire is not required between equal labels.

g.text: All components and all recorded wiring are on this page. There are no child sheets.

g.desc: All components and all recorded wiring are on this page. There are no child sheets.

g.text: RESET BOTH is represented as a normally-open switch to GND; switch model not specified.

g.desc: RESET BOTH is represented as a normally-open switch to GND; switch model not specified.

g.text: D1 -> D0 wire is physically present; current firmware does not use this UART. No firmware changes.

g.desc: D1 -> D0 wire is physically present; current firmware does not use this UART. No firmware changes.

g.text: Both USB powered; shared 3V3 is recorded as existing wiring. Rail sourcing/configuration not validated.

g.desc: Both USB powered; shared 3V3 is recorded as existing wiring. Rail sourcing/configuration not validated.

g.text: AZD-K / AXES CD / isolated 24V supply domain

g.desc: AZD-K / AXES CD / isolated 24V supply domain

g.text: CN4: all 24 pins. CN1: all five terminals. Matching labels are connected on this sheet.

g.desc: CN4: all 24 pins. CN1: all five terminals. Matching labels are connected on this sheet.

g.text: 24V negative is connected to CN4-5 (IN-COM[4-7]), NOT CN4-22 (GND).

g.desc: 24V negative is connected to CN4-5 (IN-COM[4-7]), NOT CN4-22 (GND).

g.text: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO. Minus: MCU GND. No interface parts (as-built).

g.desc: CW/CCW plus: direct 3.3V GPIO. Minus: MCU GND. No interface parts (as-built).

g.text: K1 / K2-K5: QCCAN QC19004; VCC=3V3, GND=MCU ground. Contacts have separate voltage domains.

g.desc: K1 / K2-K5: QCCAN QC19004; VCC=3V3, GND=MCU ground. Contacts have separate voltage domains.

g.text: A/B: PS1, 24V_AB and 0V_AB. C/D: PS2, 24V_CD and 0V_CD. Both 24V negative rails remain separate from MCU GND.

g.desc: A/B: PS1, 24V_AB and 0V_AB. C/D: PS2, 24V_CD and 0V_CD. Both 24V negative rails remain separate from MCU GND.

g.text: AZD-K / AXES AB / isolated 24V supply domain

g.desc: AZD-K / AXES AB / isolated 24V supply domain

g.text: Two NUCLEO-G431KB boards / four AZD-K drives / five QC19004 relays / two MDR-100-24 supplies

g.desc: Two NUCLEO-G431KB boards / four AZD-K drives / five QC19004 relays / two MDR-100-24 supplies

g.text: Manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs; 3.3V operation is outside that voltage specification.

g.desc: Manual specifies 5-24V pulse inputs; 3.3V operation is outside that voltage specification.

g.text: AC/PE, motor, encoder, brake and other I/O wiring not yet recorded. X = not drawn, not confirmed unused.

g.desc: AC/PE, motor, encoder, brake and other I/O wiring not yet recorded. X = not drawn, not confirmed unused.

g.text: IN/excitation omitted. Crossings without a dot are not connected.

g.desc: IN/excitation omitted. Crossings without a dot are not connected.

g.text: ST UM2397 Rev 2, Figure 12 / Table 11. 30 Arduino header pins; USB connector is shown as a legend.

g.desc: ST UM2397 Rev 2, Figure 12 / Table 11. 30 Arduino header pins; USB connector is shown as a legend.

g.text: SuperMEXE02 / COMPLETE HARDWARE ON ONE SHEET

g.desc: SuperMEXE02 / COMPLETE HARDWARE ON ONE SHEET

g.text: Component side, USB at top. Left: CN4 / Right: CN3. 3.n / 4.n = header pin number.

g.desc: Component side, USB at top. Left: CN4 / Right: CN3. 3.n / 4.n = header pin number.

g.text: CN4: all 24 pins. CN1: all five terminals. Matching labels are connected on this sheet.

g.desc: CN4: all 24 pins. CN1: all five terminals. Matching labels are connected on this sheet.
